scope: Public OmniGen2 T2I source audit: Recap-DataComp, LAION-Aesthetic, SAM-LLaVA. Metadata/manifests only; no image bytes, caption archives, or parquet data shards downloaded. Two metadata-only example rows fetched from the HF viewer.
units: All measured bytes are decimal bytes; GB=10^9, TB=10^12.

current_count.basis: HF /size and /rows APIs, partial=false; metadata rows are not proven distinct images or successful URL downloads.

caption_metadata.config_warning: default and condition_diverse_topk point at the same data/train_data and data/preview_data globs. Do not sum the two configs or use the HF headline 1,881,782,514 as independent images. Old card default.download_size=332,624,746,842 disagrees with current file sum and live viewer /size=527,439,673,721.

image_delivery.notes: Official instructions require img2dataset URL retrieval; availability and byte identity must be checked when images are collected. One viewer row verified schema without fetching its image.

access_license.image_license: Underlying web image rights are not established by the recaption metadata license; no per-image license field observed in schema.

storage_scenario.notes: Assumes one accepted resized/reencoded image per row. Excludes captions, tar padding, original high-resolution files, masks, intermediate features, and failed URL downloads. Does not estimate obtainable image count.

prism_recommendation.reason: A 527.44GB caption/URL scan plus web retrieval is excessive for an initial practical subset. Rich synthetic captions are useful for later scale-up. Use one pinned config, deduplication, quality checks, and a hard sample quota.

scenario_for_later_sample.notes: Assumes one accepted resized/reencoded image per row. Excludes captions, tar padding, original high-resolution files, masks, intermediate features, and failed URL downloads. Does not estimate obtainable image count.

sources.name: LAION-Aesthetic
sources.subset_identity_warning: The source name alone does not specify V1/V2, threshold, language, or exact OmniGen2 selected manifest. Historical V1 counts must not be mistaken for exact current gated revision counts.
sources.current_exact_row_count_reason: Unauthenticated /size and /splits return HTTP 401. No conditions were accepted and no gate was bypassed.
sources.overlap_warning: The art subset is nested by its stronger aesthetic filter; do not add it as independent extra images to the broad aesthetics pool. Old laion-art, multi, and nolang URLs redirect to re-LAION names in current API responses.

access_license.hf_gated: auto; contact-sharing/conditions required by current Hub pages
access_license.notes: Current audited repositories have no dataset card/license in public metadata. Verify current gated terms before ingestion; underlying images retain their own copyrights. Re-LAION is a safety-revised successor, so record exact revision rather than treating old download scripts as current.

storage_scenario_historical_120m_pool.notes: Assumes one accepted resized/reencoded image per row. Excludes captions, tar padding, original high-resolution files, masks, intermediate features, and failed URL downloads. Does not estimate obtainable image count.

prism_recommendation.reason: Gated metadata, ambiguous source variant, external URL recovery, and overlap make it a poor first reproducible source. Later prefer a bounded sample from a pinned current safety-revised release.

current_count.warning: Caption rows have not been validated as unique successfully joined images. Meta describes the original SA-1B image corpus as 11M images with 1.1B masks.

caption_metadata.notes: Original archive and auto-converted parquet are alternative representations; do not sum both as necessary downloads.

image_delivery.warning: __url__ identifies the caption archive or internal cache path, not an image URL. Meta/official SAM README advertises separate SA-1B download; the current fetched download page did not expose a verifiable image-archive manifest. Actual current image archive availability and size remain unverified.

access_license.caption_license_limitation: Card is only a generic openrail tag; full license variant/terms not present.
access_license.images: Separate SA-1B Dataset Research License; Meta lists research purposes only and limited license. SAM model/code Apache-2.0 does not license SA-1B images.

storage_scenario.notes: Assumes one accepted resized/reencoded image per row. Excludes captions, tar padding, original high-resolution files, masks, intermediate features, and failed URL downloads. Does not estimate obtainable image count.

prism_recommendation.reason: Caption payload is manageable, but training needs separate licensed SA-1B images and a validated join. Include only if a usable research-licensed SA-1B image store is already accessible or its acquisition is approved and verified.

scenario_for_later_sample.notes: Assumes one accepted resized/reencoded image per row. Excludes captions, tar padding, original high-resolution files, masks, intermediate features, and failed URL downloads. Does not estimate obtainable image count.

methodology.actual_downloads: Only small API metadata/size/split responses, official READMEs, and two text-only row examples.
methodology.file_inventory: file_manifest.json includes names, byte sizes, SHA256 when present, and revision-pinned remote URLs.
methodology.limitations: File sizes describe current remote metadata objects, not image payloads. Current row statistics are service-reported, not an independently scanned unique-image count. Archive HEAD/GET and image availability were not tested.

archive_note: Compact tracked audit; detailed file inventories and raw HTTP/API evidence remain in the verified metadata bundle on Aurora.
